expected.title: Classes whose restrictions form a basis on every fibre make the de Rham cohomology of the total space free over that of the base
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that classes in the de Rham cohomology of the total space whose restrictions to each fibre form a basis make the de Rham cohomology of the total space a free module over that of the base (statement lines 2023-2041). The proof replaces the cohomology of the total space by a Cech complex with a Hodge filtration, constructs the comparison map from a sum of shifted copies of the base complex using cocycles for the given classes, and proves it is a quasi-isomorphism by comparing graded pieces: the case $k = 0$ is the relative generation lemma and the higher cases follow by derived tensoring, using K-flatness, with an induction on the filtration to finish. The filtered comparison argument is the substance, so the claim is H2 (the author states a list of standard facts about the Cech complex without proof, referring to the discussion before the spectral sequence lemma).

expected.title: After an etale base change a finite type algebra splits into a finite part and a part quasi-finite nowhere over the point
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a finite type map and a prime of the base there is an etale neighbourhood over which the base change splits as a product of finite factors, each with a unique prime over the point, and a remainder that is quasi-finite nowhere over that point (statement lines 40578-40600). The proof does not work under a quasi-finiteness assumption: it analyses the fibre, splits off its finitely many isolated closed points, spreads them out to finite factors over an etale neighbourhood, and verifies the listed properties for the resulting decomposition (proof lines 40602-40635). Separating the isolated points of the fibre is the step that produces the finite factors. H2.

expected.title: Formal H0 comparison on a punctured spectrum under local cohomological-dimension bounds
expected.author: The Stacks Project Authors
expected.difficulty_reason: 把 H^0 的完备化技巧从规则环情形推进到一般余维数情形，两段都是本条自己完成：(i) 单射性不做归约，而是取 F 的伴随点 x，用前一段已得的 depth≥1 保证 x 的闭包与 U∩Y 相交，任取交中的 y，把 F_x 写成 F_y 的局部化，再用 Krull 交定理把 F_y 嵌入 lim F_y/I^nF_y，于是 kernel 中的截面支撑为空、必为零；(ii) 满射性对 Ass(M)\V(I) 的个数归纳：取极大的关联素因子 p_n，用赋值分裂 M'=H^0_{p_1…p_{n-1}I}(M) 与 M''=M/M'，由 dualizing 的除挠引理知 M'' 只有一个关联素因子，从而可用预备引理的 (3)(a) 得 M'' 的结论，归纳假设给 M' 的结论，最后由蛇引理拼接。难点是把“余维数条件 > cd+1”翻译成使预备引理可用的关联素因子分布形态，并用 o 数归纳把它降到单素因子情形；这一翻译不是标准先修的直接推论。
